---
title: "Rate the evidence"
---

<div class="phase-banner" id="phase">Join a session first.</div>
<div id="forms"></div>

<script>
(async function () {
  const { rpc, store, el, status, watchSession, DIRECTIONS } = Lab;
  const cards = await (await fetch("js/cards.json")).json();
  const root = document.getElementById("forms");
  let phase = null, mine = [], existing = {};

  function form(c, which) {
    const prev = existing[`${c.id}:${which}`] || {};
    const f = el("form", { class: "card" + (which === "post" ? " post" : ""), onsubmit: e => e.preventDefault() });
    f.append(el("h3", {}, `Source ${c.label}`));
    f.append(el("p", {}, el("a", { href: `studies.html#${c.id}` }, "Read the source")));
    const dir = el("div", { class: "choice-group" }, ...DIRECTIONS.map(d => el("label", {}, el("input", { type: "radio", name: "dir", value: d, ...(prev.direction === d ? { checked: "" } : {}) }), el("span", {}, d))));
    const cred = el("div", { class: "choice-group" }, ...[1,2,3,4,5].map(n => el("label", {}, el("input", { type: "radio", name: "cred", value: n, required: "", ...(prev.credibility === n ? { checked: "" } : {}) }), el("span", {}, `${n}${n===1?" low":n===5?" high":""}`))));
    const reason = el("textarea", { rows: 2, maxlength: 600, placeholder: "One sentence: why this rating?" }); reason.value = prev.reason || "";
    const st = el("div", { class: "status" });
    f.append(el("div", { class: "rating-row" }, el("strong", {}, "Direction of findings"), dir, el("strong", {}, "Credibility"), cred, el("strong", {}, "Reason (optional)"), reason),
      el("button", { class: "primary", onclick: async () => {
        const d = f.querySelector("input[name=dir]:checked"), cr = f.querySelector("input[name=cred]:checked");
        if (!cr) return status(st, "Pick a credibility rating.", false);
        try {
          await rpc("submit_rating", { p_token: store.get().token, p_study: c.id, p_phase: which, p_direction: d ? d.value : null, p_credibility: +cr.value, p_reason: reason.value });
          status(st, prev.credibility ? "Updated." : "Submitted.", true); existing[`${c.id}:${which}`] = { direction: d && d.value, credibility: +cr.value, reason: reason.value };
        } catch (e) { status(st, e.message, false); }
      } }, prev.credibility ? "Update rating" : "Submit rating"), st);
    return f;
  }

  async function render() {
    root.replaceChildren();
    if (!store.get().token) return;
    try { const r = await rpc("my_ratings", { p_token: store.get().token }); existing = Object.fromEntries(r.map(x => [`${x.study_id}:${x.phase}`, x])); } catch {}
    const studies = cards.filter(c => mine.includes(c.id));
    if (["reading", "ratings"].includes(phase)) studies.forEach(c => root.append(form(c, "pre")));
    else if (phase === "locked") root.append(el("p", {}, "Your ratings are locked."));
    else if (["standards_submit","standards_vote","final"].includes(phase)) root.append(el("p", {}, "Rating is finished. Continue to ", el("a", { href: "standards.html" }, "standards"), "."));
    if (studies.length === 0 && ["reading","ratings"].includes(phase)) root.append(el("p", {}, "No sources are assigned to your group yet. Ask the instructor."));
  }

  watchSession(sess => {
    phase = sess.phase; mine = (sess.groups && sess.groups[store.get().group_code]) || [];
    document.getElementById("phase").textContent = Lab.PHASE_TEXT[phase];
    render();
  });
})();
</script>
